faq.heading: Everything you need to know
faq.q1: What types of documents work best?
faq.a1: DataPulse AI is optimized for data-rich documents — research reports, industry white papers, case studies, market analyses, annual reports, and academic studies. The more quantitative data and distinct findings your document contains, the richer your content pack will be. Simple text documents or brochures will still work, but structured reports with statistics, charts, and sectioned conclusions yield the strongest output.
faq.q2: How does the trilingual generation work?
faq.a2: After extracting insights from your document, DataPulse AI generates content natively in English first, then produces idiomatic French and Spanish versions — not word-for-word translations. Our AI adapts phrasing, cultural nuance, and platform conventions for each language, so your French LinkedIn post reads like it was written by a Parisian marketing professional, not a translation engine.
faq.q3: Are my uploaded PDFs stored securely?
faq.a3: Yes. All uploaded files are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). Your documents are processed in isolated compute environments and are automatically deleted from our servers within 24 hours of upload unless you explicitly save a project. We never use your documents to train our AI models. Full details are available in our Privacy Policy.
faq.q4: Can I edit the generated content?
faq.a4: Absolutely. Every generated post is fully editable within the DataPulse AI dashboard before you copy or export it. You can adjust wording, swap out statistics, change hashtags, or rewrite sections entirely. You can also re-run the generation with different tone or objective settings to get alternative versions without re-uploading your document.
faq.q5: What's the difference between subscription plans and credit packs?
faq.a5: Subscription plans (Free, Starter, Professional, Business) give you a set number of document uploads per month at a fixed price — ideal if you have consistent, predictable content needs. Credit packs are one-time purchases of additional upload credits that never expire, perfect for high-volume months or one-off projects that exceed your plan's monthly quota. You can combine both: use your subscription for baseline needs and credit packs for overflow.

You'll get access to English-language output for LinkedIn and X, giving you a real sense of the content quality before you commit to a paid plan. Upgrading unlocks all three languages, all platforms, infographic copy, and higher monthly document limits.
faq.q7: Can I integrate DataPulse AI with my CMS or CRM?
faq.a7: API access is available on the Professional and Business plans. Our REST API lets you programmatically upload documents, retrieve generated content packs, and push outputs directly into platforms like HubSpot, Contentful, WordPress, or any custom CRM via webhooks. Full API documentation is available in your dashboard once you're on an eligible plan. Zapier and Make (Integromat) integrations are also on our roadmap for Q3 2026.
faq.q8: How is this different from ChatGPT or Jasper?
faq.a8: General-purpose AI writing tools like ChatGPT or Jasper start from a blank prompt — you have to tell them what your data says. DataPulse AI starts from your actual document. It reads, parses, and understands the structure and content of your PDF to surface insights you might have missed, then generates platform-specific, multilingual content packs automatically. It's the difference between a writing assistant and a dedicated data-to-content pipeline built specifically for B2B marketers who work with research and reports.
